content_data.meeting_title: Checkout Service Performance Optimization Sprint Planning
agenda_items: Evaluate migration strategy from monolithic checkout to microservices architecture
Review API rate limiting issues affecting third-party payment integrations
Plan load testing scenarios for upcoming peak shopping season
Discuss proposed Redis caching layer implementation for product catalog
key_decisions: Agreed to defer full microservices migration until after peak season, focusing on critical path optimization
Established 200ms p95 latency target for checkout API endpoints
Selected Datadog for enhanced monitoring and APM integration across checkout services
technical_blockers: Legacy payment gateway SDK lacks async support, causing thread blocking in checkout flow
Insufficient staging environment capacity to accurately simulate production traffic patterns
